item.name: Mandate
item.description: Why acquire instead of build, partner, or do nothing?
item.teaches: A defined business need, capital envelope, risk limits, executive sponsor, and decision authority.

item.name: Thesis & Targets
item.description: What must be true, and which targets fit and can actually be bought?
item.teaches: Thesis conditions, ranked target screen, pass rationale, ownership map, control path, and initial downside test.

item.name: First Look & Underwriting
item.description: Do access, standalone economics, financing, and downside support a bid?
item.teaches: Minimum information package, reconstructed financials, valuation range, financing case, and private price ceiling.

item.name: LOI & Diligence
item.description: Are core terms clear, and can the team test the conditions behind the thesis?
item.teaches: Approved LOI, evidence requests, workflow tests, accountable workstream owners, and a live issue log.
item.educationalLevel: Gates 5–6 · Exclusivity approved and diligence launched

item.name: Re-underwrite & Sign
item.description: Does the deal still work on the facts and terms now in front of the buyer?
item.teaches: Revised valuation and synergy case, combined downside, final economics, protections, closing conditions, and integration owners.

item.name: Close & Day 1
item.description: Can funds and control transfer while the business keeps working?
item.teaches: Funds flow, required consents and clearances, closing checklist, and customer, cash, people, and system readiness.
item.educationalLevel: Gates 9–10 · Closing approved and Day 1 stable

item.name: Value Delivery & Review
item.description: Has the buyer delivered the underwritten value, and what should change next time?
item.teaches: 30/60/100-day reviews, realized cash benefits and costs, workflow decisions, revised forecasts, and residual action owners.
item.educationalLevel: Gates 11–12 · Value delivery confirmed and program closed

hasDefinedTerm.name: Corporate development
hasDefinedTerm.description: Set the acquisition mandate, prioritize targets, and carry evidence from sourcing through investment approval and operating ownership.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Valuation
hasDefinedTerm.description: Build a defensible valuation range, separate standalone economics from buyer-created value, and connect evidence to price discipline.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Financial modeling
hasDefinedTerm.description: Turn operating assumptions into cash flows, valuation ranges, and acquisition decisions using five downloadable company models.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Comparable-company analysis
hasDefinedTerm.description: Choose comparable public companies, review trading multiples and financial definitions, and support a valuation range.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Deal structure & negotiation
hasDefinedTerm.description: Separate price from funding, compare forms of consideration, and assign unresolved risks before committing to acquisition terms.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Due diligence
hasDefinedTerm.description: Test earnings, transferability, and operating dependencies with a 112-item diligence checklist that connects findings to deal consequences.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Synergies
hasDefinedTerm.description: Turn synergy claims into risk-adjusted cash benefits, separate buyer-created value, and assign the operating work required to deliver it.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Integration
hasDefinedTerm.description: Protect business continuity, assign operating decisions, and track acquisition value with a 104-action post-deal integration checklist.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Divestitures & carve-outs
hasDefinedTerm.description: Define what transfers, expose seller dependencies, and plan the path from Day 1 continuity to independent operations.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Strategic finance
hasDefinedTerm.description: Compare buying with alternatives, test liquidity and downside constraints, and set a private acquisition price ceiling.
